name: 郭志宇
objective: A brief introduction of general chemistry and chemical reactions, covering atomic structure and bonding, quantitative chemistry, gas, thermodynamics, kinetics, etc. In addition to the basic principles of chemistry, this course will focus on letting students understand the relationship between chemistry and daily life.
課程進度(1-16週):
Week/Topic
1    Instruction/Chemistry: An Introduction
2    Measurements and Calculations 
3    Measurements and Calculations
4    Matter
5    Chemical Foundations: Elements, Atoms, and Ions 
6    Chemical Foundations: Elements, Atoms, and Ions
7    Nomenclature
8    Chemical Reactions: An Introduction
9    Midterm
10  Reactions in Aqueous Solutions
11  Chemical Composition
12  Chemical Composition
13  Chemical Quantities
14  Energy
15  Energy
16  Final
17  Flexible Learning/ Modern Atomic Theory
18  Flexible Learning/ Modern Atomic Theory
